items.title: AOMEI Backupper update servers hijacked to push malware: Check your PC
items.content: Between April and July 2026, attackers compromised AOMEI Technology's update and notification infrastructure to distribute malware to users of AOMEI Backupper, backup software used by over 100 million people worldwide. During three confirmed tampering windows lasting ten, six, and five minutes, attackers modified download instructions to deliver a malicious ZIP archive containing an initial... This pulse includes 3 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: upgrade-now.exe.

items.title: Plex vulnerabilities being exploited in the wild to drop a cryptominer
items.content: Multiple Plex Media Server vulnerabilities announced in September 2026 are being actively exploited to deploy cryptominers and proxy software. The exploitation chains together four CVEs to achieve remote code execution on vulnerable Plex servers. A honeypot deployment captured exploitation attempts from multiple IP addresses starting October 17, 2026. Attackers deployed XMRig cryptominer and... This pulse includes 15 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: XMRig, myawesomeproxy.

items.title: QuartzLine: A working PDF viewer with a backdoor inside
items.content: QuartzLine, also tracked as CLOUDHAZE by Mandiant, is malicious software disguised as a functional Windows PDF viewer that conceals a backdoor enabling attackers to execute commands and deploy additional malware. The malware has appeared as paperline.exe and fielddesk.exe, signed with a legitimate but now-revoked EV code-signing certificate. Distribution occurs through malicious advertising,... This pulse includes 18 indicators of compromise (IOCs). Associated malware: QuartzLine, CLOUDHAZE, Caira.

items.title: ConnectWise (SkyKick) Vendor Credentials Abused in M365 Attacks
items.content: A Microsoft 365 API credential belonging to ConnectWise Cloud Backup (formerly SkyKick) was compromised and used to gain unauthorized access to customer M365 environments. The threat actor authenticated from IP address 144.172.64.128 on October 15, obtaining Microsoft Graph access tokens across hundreds of tenants.
